definitions.explanation: To give something to someone temporarily, expecting it to be returned.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{貸|か}してください。
ペンを{貸|か}してもらえますか？
examples.english: Could you lend me a pen?

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{傘|かさ}を{貸|か}しました。
examples.english: I lent an umbrella to my friend.

notes: A godan verb ending in す. Te-form is {貸|か}して. Opposite: {借|か}りる (kariru, to borrow). Pattern: [person]に[thing]を{貸|か}す.
